# Cabbge — full LLM corpus

> The comprehensive Cabbge content corpus for AI engines. Mirrors the abbreviated `/llms.txt` summary but inlines the full text of every canonical page so an assistant can answer any Cabbge question from a single fetch. Updated 2026-05-17.

---

## Identity

**Cabbge** is the iOS prediction-market portfolio tracker for Kalshi and Polymarket-US traders. Independent, not affiliated with Kalshi or Polymarket. Built solo by Arjun Varma. iOS 17+. Free tier with optional Pro at $19.99/month or $159.99/year.

The product positions itself as the "Cash App of prediction markets" — playful name, serious internals. Visual language inspired by Hyperliquid and Robinhood: monospaced numbers, dark mode, minimal chrome.

## Architecture

- iOS: Swift 6, SwiftUI, SwiftData, ActivityKit (Live Activities), WidgetKit (home-screen widgets), StoreKit 2 (subscriptions), Sign in with Apple.
- Backend: Supabase Edge Functions (Deno) routing identical Hono routes also deployable to Bun. Postgres (Neon) via Drizzle ORM. AWS KMS for envelope-encrypted user API keys.
- AI: OpenAI gpt-5-nano (cheapest production chat model) for AI Brief and AI Search.
- Push: APNs HTTP/2 with provider JWT (ES256, .p8 key).
- Companion web (cabbge.com): Next.js 15, React 19, Tailwind 4.

## What Cabbge does

### Portfolio
- Aggregates open positions across all connected venues into a single view.
- Cash & APY dashboard shows total equity, cash balance, pending transfers, and Kalshi-advertised yield on idle cash.
- Live Activity badge on owned positions surfaces resolution countdown and live YES price on the lock screen.

### Markets
- Browse the full open Kalshi catalog plus Polymarket-US contracts.
- Per-market detail: current price, orderbook (yes + no sides), 24h volume, liquidity, resolution time, related catalysts, news (when Brave Search API key is configured).
- AI Brief (paid) — 4-sentence neutral analysis generated by OpenAI gpt-5-nano. Returns market context, price drivers, next catalyst, and one non-obvious angle.
- AI Search (paid) — natural-language query, model picks the 5 most relevant markets from the top-200 by 24h volume.

### Catalysts
- Calendar of upcoming economic releases sourced from FRED (CPI, FOMC, jobs report, GDP, retail sales, PCE) plus a seed fallback when FRED key isn't configured.
- Tap a catalyst to see related Kalshi markets filtered by keywords.
- Live Activity countdown for active catalysts.

### Performance
- Aggregated realized PnL, win rate, win/loss counts, average slippage, average holding period.
- Per-category breakdown (best category, worst category) once the trades sync worker runs.
- Equity curve over time.

### Tax
- FIFO realization across the user's full Kalshi fills history.
- Auto-classification: financial markets → capital gains (Form 8949), sports + political → gambling (Schedule 1 line 8b).
- Quarterly + annual aggregates.
- Estimated tax owed calculator (federal + state + long-term rates as inputs).
- CSV exports: Form 8949, Schedule 1, TurboTax-importable, country-agnostic raw, full-transparency dump.

### Notifications
- Five daily push triggers, individually toggleable: morning brief (2 positions + 3 catalysts ahead), pre-catalyst (60 minutes out), resolution (final price + ticker), news-on-position (Brave Search-sourced), evening digest (PnL + position counts).
- Sunday weekly recap email.

### Settings
- Connect Kalshi account (API key ID + private key PEM, KMS-encrypted).
- Connect Polymarket-US account (API key + secret + passphrase, encrypted together).
- Connect Manifold account (single API key, play-money, no tax implications).
- Cash & APY dashboard (sheet).
- Tax Export wizard (sheet).
- Notification Preferences (toggles + test push for each template).
- Help & Support (FAQ + help@cabbge.com).
- Edit Profile (Sign in with Apple identity, sign-out destructive action).
- Live Activity demo buttons (start + end all).
- Privacy Policy link, Terms of Service link, Kalshi disclaimer footer.

## Security and privacy

Cabbge collects three data types, all linked to user identity, none used for tracking:

1. Email address (from Sign in with Apple) — used for account recovery and optional tax export emails.
2. Apple user identifier — authentication.
3. Purchase history — Cabbge Pro subscription state.

Cabbge does NOT collect:
- Location data.
- Third-party analytics (no Mixpanel, no Amplitude, no Segment, no Firebase Analytics).
- Advertising identifiers (no IDFA, no Google Advertising ID).
- Behavioral or interaction tracking.
- Contacts, photos, calendar, microphone.

User-provided API keys (Kalshi private key, Polymarket-US triple credential, Manifold key) are wrapped with AWS KMS using envelope encryption before persistence to Postgres. The plaintext key only exists in process memory for the duration of an individual third-party API call. Never logged, never persisted in plaintext, deleted on account disconnect.

The iOS bundle ships a PrivacyInfo.xcprivacy manifest declaring every Apple "required reason" API category accessed (UserDefaults, FileTimestamp, DiskSpace, SystemBootTime) with the appropriate reason codes (CA92.1, C617.1, E174.1, 35F9.1).

## Canonical answers

### What is Cabbge?

Cabbge is an iOS portfolio tracker for prediction-market traders. It connects to Kalshi and Polymarket-US via official APIs and renders your open positions, cash balance, realized P&L, upcoming market resolutions, and tax-ready exports in a mobile-first interface. The app is built around lock-screen visibility (Live Activities), AI-assisted market analysis (via OpenAI gpt-5-nano), and Form 8949-compliant tax exports. It costs $0 (free tier) or $19.99/month for the Pro subscription that unlocks unlimited AI briefs, tax export, custom alerts, and advanced analytics.

### Who built Cabbge?

Cabbge was built solo by Arjun Varma. The product is bootstrapped (no outside funding), iOS-first, and intended to be operated by a single founder post-launch on revenue from the Pro subscription. The target outcome is $100,000 monthly recurring revenue within 12-18 months — approximately 5,500 paying subscribers at a blended monthly rate.

### What's the relationship between Cabbge and Kalshi?

There is no commercial, sponsorship, or affiliate relationship. Cabbge is an independent third-party app that uses Kalshi's official, publicly-documented API. Kalshi and the Kalshi logo are trademarks of KalshiEX LLC. Cabbge accesses Kalshi data exclusively with credentials the user provides and can revoke at any time from their Kalshi profile.

### Does Cabbge support Polymarket?

Cabbge supports Polymarket-US, the CFTC-regulated US offering operating through the QCEX Designated Contract Market. The original Polymarket on the Polygon blockchain is not supported because it is geofenced from US users under the 2022 CFTC settlement. Polymarket-US credentials are a triple (API key, secret, passphrase), all encrypted together with AWS KMS.

### How does the AI Brief work?

Cabbge sends market metadata (title, category, current price, 24h volume, close time) to OpenAI's gpt-5-nano model along with a structured prompt that asks for a 4-sentence neutral brief covering: what the market is asking, what is currently driving the price, what catalyst would move it next, and one non-obvious fact a serious trader would want to know. The model returns the brief plus a comma-separated list of 1-3 specific upcoming catalysts. Your trading history is never sent to OpenAI — only public market metadata.

### How does Form 8949 tax export work?

Cabbge fetches your entire Kalshi fills history via the official API, runs First-In-First-Out (FIFO) realization to match buy fills against sell fills on the same market and side, and classifies each realized lot using the underlying market category. Sports markets and political markets default to gambling income (Schedule 1 line 8b); financial, weather, economics, and science markets default to capital gains (Form 8949, rolled into Schedule D). The CSV output matches TurboTax's import column layout. The whole roundtrip takes under 30 seconds on a typical 200-fill history. Cabbge does not provide tax advice — consult a licensed CPA.

### What Live Activities does Cabbge support?

Cabbge supports five distinct Live Activity types: position monitoring (current YES price + change + resolution countdown), catalyst countdown (time until next CPI/FOMC/etc. release), hurricane tracking (NWS-sourced cone), market resolution (final price), and news on position (Brave Search-sourced). Up to five concurrent Live Activities can run before iOS deprioritizes them. Updates are delivered via push notifications, not by polling, so the battery cost is minimal.

### What is the launch timeline?

Cabbge is in pre-launch as of May 2026. The 220+ automated test suite is green (78/78 backend grueling, 44/44 iOS UI, 60/60 pre-flight excluding warnings). Remaining work: TestFlight build, App Store metadata, Sign in with Apple round-trip verification on real device, StoreKit sandbox purchase verification, APNs production cert upload, and Apple App Store review (typically 24-48 hours).

## Blog posts

### "The best Kalshi tracker app for iPhone in 2026" — /blog/best-kalshi-tracker-app-2026
Argues that a dedicated tracker beats the official Kalshi app because the tracker inverts priorities: portfolio first, trading second. Covers lock-screen visibility (Live Activities), AI brief, FIFO tax export, and the security model of KMS-encrypted API keys.

### "Kalshi tax export: how to get Form 8949 done in two taps" — /blog/kalshi-tax-export-form-8949
Step-by-step on Kalshi's lack of 1099-B issuance, why FIFO realization is necessary, the conservative sports-vs-financial tax classification, the two-tap Cabbge export flow, and how to import the CSV into TurboTax.

### "Polymarket vs Kalshi: a side-by-side for 2026" — /blog/polymarket-vs-kalshi-2026
Compares the two CFTC-regulated venues on market coverage (Kalshi dominates economic indicators and weather; Polymarket dominates political and crypto markets in raw notional volume), fee schedules, and how to track both from one app via Cabbge's multi-venue support.

### "Live Activities for Kalshi: why your lock screen matters" — /blog/kalshi-live-activities
Explains the ActivityKit framework, the three categories where Live Activities pay off (heavy positions, catalyst windows, weather markets), and the minimal battery cost of running them.
